ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 70-75% of the visible surface, contrasted by a central low-intensity (black) wedge and distributed dark spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) mass radiating from the peduncle junction; high-intensity (white) background features numerous discrete, non-contiguous circular dark pixel clusters across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior vertex; aperture angle estimated between 65 and 80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the lateral halves of both lobes, exhibiting a jagged, saw-tooth morphology.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave curve from the notch to the tips; distal tips show an outward and slightly upward swept orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed high-contrast dark circular regions (diameter variations 5-25 pixels) throughout the white background, consistent with barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible; most prominent are vertical rake-like marks on the right lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant three-dimensional biological encrustation and protruding barnacle clusters localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of high-density biological growth on the absolute lateral margins, creating an irregular, jagged profile beyond the natural fluke edge.
